summaries: Aborting a governance handoff now returns the Fence to the Governance-Hash it replaced, so a later apply-governance starts the handoff again instead of reporting it unchanged.

At own_target_reuse accept_record with test_group_report refuse_missing_groups, QA's final test run accepts the passing full-suite pre-handoff run and takes its group report, when that run binds the same group declaration and every declared group passed, instead of launching the suite again.
Let an autopilot grant that allows phase_start run the next entry once the owning compiler reads the prior phase closed.
Take an allowed queued recommendation automatically unless the caller explicitly records a reason to hold it.

A role that starts background agents or commands now waits for their output files in its own turn with the packaged await_outputs.py, since a host may deliver the completion notice to the top session instead.

Add backlog_compile.py precheck, a write-free mechanical check the writer runs before the first review manifest: story criteria without a tracing scenario, scenario row lists that differ from their declared rows, Dependencies links not declared in depends_on, a deliverable supplied by two stories, and stale root backlog counts.
The generated backlog board shows a story a merged Delivery integrated as delivered, naming that Delivery, and says when a Delivery's merge state cannot be read instead of guessing.

Add delivery_compile.py close-external: the owner closes a Delivery whose integrated work reached the target outside merge-pr, recording the decision, reason and carrying pull request; unfinished Items are cancelled so their Stories return to planning, and the closure audit reads the Delivery as closed instead of an open external_product_merge blocker.
Surface pending Item decisions when an execution plan is published so the owner can answer before the Item starts.
Wait out an Environment Contract's declared steady-state window before collecting logs.
Execution planning now states that overlapping path claims of unfinished Items are refused whatever their execution order, matching the compiler.
Attest the Experience Git restore and merge after later ordinary merges advance the target branch past the open Fence target, as long as the approved Experience tree is unchanged.

Add process switch process_profile with a fast_lane value: the deliver entry turns a request into one task (knowledge or build, sized against targets.json), one branch and one pull request verified by CI and one reviewer (two at rigor high) with auto-merge, and the Item-based flow stays as deliver-governed; the retrospective reports time, API-equivalent cost, quality and rework causes per task kind, writes recurring causes to a lessons file and files approved proposals as issues; spawns pick their model by purpose class; impact-based role routing requires the software architect on structural build tasks; backlog-plan, delivery-plan, execution-plan and deliver-governed leave the user's menu.

Add process switch finding_disposition: at follow_up_issue only a critical Delivery finding blocks an Item, every finding below it is a complete follow-up recorded in the evidence and Delivery Review, and follow-up-issues lists one project issue per follow-up for the coordinator to file.
push-item accepts an active Item record whose generated relation block render-relations rewrote; only its authored content beyond the Architecture stamp is refused.
Record the host sleep and network loss interruptions a live run saw as advisory interruptions_seen on every live run record, passing runs included, without changing verdicts or the resume rule.

Add process switches live_verification and item_live_gate: at delivery_integration story QA passes run no live tests and record live: deferred_to_integration, and the Delivery runs one impact-selected live run at integration; at tooling_items an Item that changes environment tooling runs its affected live groups once before merge.

Add process switch `pr_proof` (`remote_ci` | `local_record`): at `local_record`, the new `task_lane.py prove` runs the project's declared proof commands (`.agentrof/local-proof.json`, by default the test command and the vault gate) on HEAD and records each exit code and duration with the HEAD commit and a clean-tree flag, and fast-lane `open-pr` refuses before pushing unless that record is green for the clean HEAD, then adds it to the pull request body as a Local proof section.

Switching a measurement-only process switch (step timing, baselines, budgets, cost report, lane table, review scope record) no longer invalidates a pinned backlog review round or drifts a Delivery's pin.

Add process switch pass_carry_over: at per_item the runner keeps every pass record the approved test or live command writes, failed passes included, in the Item's carry-over record and names it to the next pass in AGENTROF_CARRY_OVER_RECORD.

The Delivery runner now names each Item's kept runtime checkout runtime-<delivery>-<story> and each command clone checkout-<suffix>, so environments named after the checkout folder no longer collide when several Items are verified at once.

claim-items now keeps the Item claims its own Delivery already holds and claims only the Items a plan revision added, instead of refusing on the first existing claim and leaving the added Items without refs.

refresh-target now accepts a story, test plan or Process Policy that a held plan revision has already re-pinned locally to the target's bytes, and takes the target copy, so a backlog revision approved mid-Delivery no longer deadlocks publish-execution-plan against refresh-target.
Show production-caller, command-dispatch and record-writer gaps in the frozen code review inputs.
Fast-lane `prove` keeps the distinct failing test ids of each red command in its record, and `open-pr`'s refusal names them.
Let publish-execution-plan take a Verification Contract that re-pair restamped at the same revision for a later Environment Contract.
A declared QA verb run after the final down no longer forces another down before settlement.
The vault property schema now registers the fixes property that task_lane start --fixes writes, so a rework task passes the vault gate instead of failing with an unknown frontmatter property.
Select repair-pass review lenses from the last reviewed candidate when its bindings and ancestry remain valid.

Fast-lane retro report: a task pull request with no CI checks whose body holds the Local proof section is green when it opens, and its CI step is the proof's own minutes, so the CI and merge-wait steps are no longer empty at `pr_proof: local_record`.

Add the retired story status: a story the owner drops keeps its file with retired_at and retired_reason, so approved review history still resolves; it leaves ordering, coverage and Delivery planning, its historical reviews keep covering it, and a live story may not depend on it.

Add process switch repair_pass: at scoped_repair a repair of Delivery findings below critical, reviewed before freeze and covered by a passing touched-suites run, is frozen and settled by scoped-repair without a new full reader and QA pass.

At review_rounds single_pass the backlog compiler now refuses a recheck record or a new draft review round that follows a pass with no critical finding, so a major or minor finding becomes a follow-up instead of another round.

Add process switch item_verification: at single_verifier one fresh verifier reviews the frozen Item diff, runs QA's approved commands and registers the code review and QA results together with single-verifier-result; only a critical finding blocks and every other finding is a follow-up issue.
Document the order of a backlog revision during an active Delivery: source handoff verbs, plan revision barrier, then refresh-target.

stamp-item and the Delivery architecture delta check now read a claimed record kind such as interface as its record type, so an Item that claims an interface record can stamp its architecture delta; a delta outside the claimed kinds still refuses.
A role check recorded in the task file after the local proof no longer invalidates the proof, so the pull request opens without a full re-run when that is the only change since.
Allow approval-bound amendments of unheld product paths for active serial Items without a full plan revision.
Generate a current verification-command and refusal reference for planning and review inputs.
